review_text: We tried dining at BRGR Alley Cafe in Mintal earlier today and overall it was a good experience. Their burgers were flavorful, well-seasoned, and juicy. The serving size was just right and satisfying. Price-wise, it feels slightly on the higher side for me based on the serving and taste, but that doesn’t mean we wouldn’t come back hehe. The overall experience still makes it worth visiting. The place has a chill and cozy vibe, the crew was attentive, and the food was served surprisingly fast. They also have plenty of parking spaces at the back, which is very convenient. Verdict: WORTH THE STOP

I don’t even know where to start—the food was just that good. If you're wondering if it's worth heading outside the city center just for a burger, the answer is a resounding yes. The service was great, but what really caught me off guard was how nice the washroom is! It sounds funny to mention, but it was honestly impressive. A total 10/10 experience all around.
From the bun to the patties, so good for me. First time to try their green honey elixir drink, and it was indeed refreshing. Will definitely come back

I had a great experience at Burger Alley! The food is absolutely delicious—every bite was flavorful and freshly prepared. The ambiance is really nice and cozy, making it a perfect place to relax and enjoy your meal. What stood out the most was the excellent customer service. The staff were very accommodating, friendly, and attentive to our needs. Highly recommended, and I will definitely be coming back! 🍔✨

Brgr Alley is near our house but it's my first time to come here with my partner 🩷 Truly a relaxing experience with good food and very kind staff. The type of staff that you would imagine if Philippines was described as hospitable and warm! Also we were warmly greeted by their resident cats Macoy and Olo 🐱🐱 so if you're a cat purrson, this place is perfect for you! 1000000/10 burgers would visit again on a random weekend 💕💕 more power!

The food was super kalami. The staff were all friendly and accommodating, and they even offered to take pictures for us, which made the experience even more special. It’s quite pricey, but the taste and overall experience definitely made it worth the price. I would gladly come back again.

One of the BEST BURGERS I've tried here in Davao! PLUS relaxing ambience with their siargao vibe landscape, cool breeze, and bonus pa ang live entertainment! Sulit gyud ang byahe! Will definitely come back!❤️
The staffs were so accomodating and appoachable. Foods are great. If you're a nature lover, and looking for an excellent quality burgers/food this place is where you should consider.
Food was great, very cosy and dreamy ang ambiance ng place, and service is commendable! Will be back here for sure.

We ordered the meat quesadilla, hot Americano, and caramel drink — all delicious! The place has a nice nipa hut vibe that makes it relaxing and cozy. Great food, friendly staff. Highly recommended! 🌿✨✌️🫡❤️
Food was great. Especially the burger. Worth the price. Atmosphere is great. Nature vibes. Most of all, friendly and approachable staffs 🤍
Very yummy and well-prepared. Nabusog gyud mi, thank you kaayo! We also appreciate the warm welcome and accommodating staff. Great experience overall! 😊✨

I ordered Whistle burger with mild spice; the service is well, the atmosphere feels like you're in some resort vacation. But we came here for the food and I'll like to say: I've enjoyed it and would love to come back here. The appetizer (Onion crisps)- it's crispy in and out, but the onion is sliced almostly thinly. They added edible flower toppings for an appealing decor. The main (mines; whistle burger with mild spice)- I love the patty in the burger isn't greasy to the point it hurts your head and somehow crispy too from it's sides! The buns are so fluffy and soft to bite on, great for those who only wanted something you can chew on. The toppings has enough spice to handle because of the jalapenos (but it's also optional to ask for spicy sauce and there's an intense option; though costly 300+). Drink (Peach pop)- there are caffeinated drinks for coffee lovers; however I choose it because I like fruity drinks. Originally ordering the Dragon one but it was sold out🥲, anyways- the fruity drinks were around 200+ pesos because of a special blend that was put in along with flower decor. Not sugary, not intense with its fruity flavor, yet it's good enough for others to drink to. I'm so thankful to getthe chance to eat at Burger Alley! 😁
We ate and left no crumbs bro. So goooood!! Coming back hereee. A hidden gem istg 😫💓 Someone cooked frrr! Highly recommended 🫶
Best Burger I have had in Philippines! Nice garden atmosphere and even mosquito repellent if needed, oh and ice cold SML 😊

My initial order was missing the pineapple, but as soon as I raised the concern, they quickly replaced it with the correct one, no hassle at all. I recently visited Brgr Alley, and overall, it was a solid experience. The burger was flavorful, with a juicy, well-seasoned patty and a soft, lightly toasted bun that held everything together nicely. The toppings were fresh and generous, especially the crisp lettuce and melted cheese. Their quesadilla were hot and crispy, and soft inside. The staff was friendly and the service was quick, even during the dinner rush. The restaurant was clean and had a casual, bali inspired setting. Prices were reasonable considering the portion sizes and quality. I’d give the burger a solid 8 out of 10, and the overall experience a 4 out of 5 stars. I’d definitely return for another bite.

I didn’t want it to be super spicy cause I also ordered their special, Mexican Cajun Wings, which is so good. Love the burger was just expecting the patty to be thicker. We had their Whistle Burger which one of the key ingredients was jalapeño pepper, and it did not disappoint, it was hot as hell, but flavorful of a burger. We also had their Alley Style Nachos which was very crispy and the beef salsa toppings were just right. It is a good place for a family or friends simple dining. The staff were friendly and accomodating, overall their service was good. A must visit place if you are near the area.

I’ve eaten there countless times but the recent experience is something that I need to share. To be fair, I didn’t experience this during my prior visits, I usually go there past lunch since they don’t open at noon, sometimes I eat on my own sometimes i bring friends, the crew then was fine and nice. Unfortunately, the recent one is something i found unacceptable, I don’t know if that particular server is new, as I’m not good with remembering faces, BUT SHE WAS REALLY RUDE. We got there, chose the A-line hut, ordered, and just talking while we were eating, then came this crew with our bill (we didn’t asked for it as we’re not done eating),she asked if she could get the plates (thinking she’ll only get those finished plates, we said okay) but to our surprise she took everything, and sprayed cleaner in the table right in front of us. like she wanted us to leave immediately. its was traumatic, so we just paid and left the place. we weren’t doing anything to deserve that treatment, ive been to a lot of restaurants and hotels in metro manila, and in most cities in this country but i’ve never been treated like this, i will be sad not to see that place anymore because i enjoyed their burgers but i think they forgot that in that line of business, good customer service definitely puts one at par with the others. i was contemplating doing this review but i decided to do this hoping it prevents other people from experiencing the same. the burgers are good but not good enough to allow someone to make you feel bad.

The good: The burgers are A+! The bun isn’t too thick and the patty is really meaty! I also love how they cut up their onion rings so they’re easier to eat. We tried their wings and they were crispy and wasn’t drowning in batter. I was also impressed by how quickly our orders arrived but maybe because we missed the dinner rush (8:15-ish na kami dumating). The staff were also very attentive and polite. Points of improvement: The nachos were so-so. Very generous with the beef but I couldn’t taste the nachos-y taste (like taco seasoning). The chips:beef ratio also didn’t match. The huts were all filled so we sat at the shack-type of seat and it wasn’t very comfy cuz masyadong malayo ang table from the seat lol. All in all would recommend! :)
Lovettee, the environment is very peaceful and they provide accomodations for you to be comfortable. The food was amazing and the taste is very delicious, it's fresh, and juicy. Highly recommend.

However do bring your family or special someone here and have a chit-chat but do come early as the kubos are the first to get full.

It's a good place good ambiance
